=== showall
v #+STARTUP: showall hideblocks
v * A
v :PROPERTIES:
h :ID: 1
h :END:
v #+begin_src sh
h ls
h #+end_src
v - item
v   more
v * Old :ARCHIVE:
h old
h ** sub
v * B
v b

=== blocks

h :END:

h :END:
v #+begin_quote

v #+end_quote
v ** B
v text
v #+begin_src lua
v print(1)
v #+end_src
